content:
luca_prod: Quick question  my June net pay is down ~CAD 320 and my payslip shows Quebec provincial tax withheld (QST/RP) even though I live in Ontario (Toronto). I never lived in QC. Anyone seen this?

sara_payroll: Thanks for flagging, Luca. Can you paste the redacted lines from the stub? Also did you travel to QC recently or update your address?

luca_prod: Redacted stub:

```
Pay period: 06/01/2026 - 06/15/2026
Gross pay: CAD 6,000.00
Federal tax: CAD 1,100.00
CPP: CAD 300.00
EI: CAD 90.00
Quebec tax (provincial): CAD 320.00
Ontario tax: CAD 0.00
Net pay: CAD 3,190.00
```

sara_payroll: Our payroll file shows province code QC for your employee record. That can happen if the postal code was entered with a QC prefix or if we accidentally mapped a contractor record with QC province. I'll pull the HRIS entry.

megan_hr: I checked HRIS  your profile shows ON, but you had an old contractor billing address with QC on file from 2019 that wasn't archived. I just deactivated the contractor record and updated your primary address to ON explicitly.

paul_finance: Operational note: Canada payroll remittance to CRA and Revenu QuE9bec likely already included the QC withholding for the pay date 06/15 if the payroll send occurred. If remittance cleared, reclaim versus off-cycle correction determines timing. We should also check RL-1/T4 reporting: if QC amounts are posted to RL-1 we may need to issue corrected RL-1 and T4 (or T4 Summary adjustments).

sara_payroll: I'll open adjustment ticket CA-ADJ-4102. If remittance not yet processed we can reverse before settlement and post ON withholding instead. If remitted to Revenu QuE9bec, we'll request a refund from Revenu QuE9bec and post an off-cycle credit to you.

luca_prod: Do I need to file anything with Revenu QuE9bec personally? I haven't filed QC returns and don't want to be stuck claiming refunds.

paul_finance: If we can reverse at payroll level and recover funds before RL-1 and T4 prep there's no employee action. If remittance already occurred and a corrected RL-1/T4 is required, we'll provide the RL-1C and T4C paperwork to attach to any provincial filings. Typically employer-initiated corrections mean the employee doesn't have to file to reclaim withheld tax, but we will coordinate with tax counsel if a temporary personal claim becomes necessary.

sara_payroll: CA-ADJ-4102 created and assigned to sara_payroll. Estimated timeline: attempt reversal 3 business days; if reclaim required, recovery may take 4-6 weeks. We'll post a provisional "Correction: Provincial withholding adjustment (06/15/2026)" in the off-cycle stub.

megan_hr: Also adding a quick procedural change: archiving old contractor billing addresses during conversions so old province codes don't leak into payroll. I'll add to the HR conversions checklist.

luca_prod: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help 44d. Please ping here when the off-cycle posts so I can confirm net.

payroll-bot: CA-ADJ-4102 created and assigned to sara_payroll. Estimated resolution: 2026-06-25.
